title: APEX Notification Envelope
description: Structured envelope for all APEX-specific notifications (order events, market events, risk events, session events).

event_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this event

event_type.description: The APEX notification type (e.g., apex.order.filled, apex.market.candle_closed)

account_id.description: Account associated with this event, if applicable

instrument_id.description: Instrument associated with this event, if applicable

resource_uri.description: The resource URI affected by this event, if applicable

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred
